text: 知情人士称，摩根大通已向尼日利亚中央银行缴存 500 亿奈拉（折合 3800 万美元），向着在这个非洲人口第一大国获取银行牌照再进一步。不愿具名的知情人士表示，这笔保证金是拿到审批前最后的监管要求之一，标志这家美国最大银行已做好准备；一旦申请获批，即可在尼日利亚开展商人银行业务。知情人士称，如果各项审批顺利，该行预计将在 2026 年底或 2027 年初取得牌照。但摩根大通未必一定能成功拿牌，最终决定权仍在尼日利亚央行。摩根大通拒绝发表评论，尼日利亚央行发言人暂未回应置评请求。
text_en: People familiar with the matter said JPMorgan has deposited 50 billion naira (equivalent to $38 million) with the Central Bank of Nigeria, moving a step further toward obtaining a banking license in Africa's most populous country. The people, who declined to be named, said the deposit is one of the final regulatory requirements before approval and marks that the largest U.S. bank is ready to conduct merchant banking business in Nigeria once its application is approved. The people said that if all approvals proceed smoothly, the bank expects to obtain the license by the end of 2026 or early 2027. But JPMorgan may not necessarily succeed in obtaining the license, and the final decision still rests with the Central Bank of Nigeria. JPMorgan declined to comment, and a spokesperson for the Central Bank of Nigeria did not immediately respond to a request for comment.
